tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check the authentication status of the Microsoft Graph connection. Returns whether the user is authenticated and shows their basic profile information.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile information including display name, email, job title, and department.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for users in the organization by name or email address. Returns matching users with their basic profile information.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific user by their ID or email address. Returns profile information including name, email, job title, and department.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all Microsoft Teams that the current user is a member of. Returns team names, descriptions, and IDs.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List all channels in a specific Microsoft Team. Returns channel names, descriptions, types, and IDs for the specified team.

tools.name: get_channel_messages
tools.description: Retrieve recent messages from a specific channel in a Microsoft Team. Returns message content, sender information, and timestamps.

contentFormat.description: Format for message content. "markdown" (default) converts Teams HTML to clean Markdown optimized for LLMs. "raw" returns original HTML from Graph API.

tools.name: send_channel_message
tools.description: Send a message to a specific channel in a Microsoft Team. Supports text and markdown formatting, mentions, and importance levels.

mentions.description: Array of @mentions to include in the message

userId.description: Azure AD User ID of the mentioned user

imageUrl.description: URL of an image to attach to the message

imageData.description: Base64 encoded image data to attach

imageFileName.description: Name for the attached image file

tools.name: get_channel_message_replies
tools.description: Get all replies to a specific message in a channel. Returns reply content, sender information, and timestamps.

messageId.description: Message ID to get replies for

contentFormat.description: Format for message content. "markdown" (default) converts Teams HTML to clean Markdown optimized for LLMs. "raw" returns original HTML from Graph API.

tools.name: reply_to_channel_message
tools.description: Reply to a specific message in a channel. Supports text and markdown formatting, mentions, and importance levels.

mentions.description: Array of @mentions to include in the reply

userId.description: Azure AD User ID of the mentioned user

imageUrl.description: URL of an image to attach to the reply

imageData.description: Base64 encoded image data to attach

imageFileName.description: Name for the attached image file

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List all members of a specific Microsoft Team. Returns member names, email addresses, roles, and IDs.

tools.name: search_users_for_mentions
tools.description: Search for users to mention in messages. Returns users with their display names, email addresses, and mention IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: download_message_hosted_content
tools.description: Download hosted content (such as images) from a Teams channel message. Returns the content as base64 encoded data along with metadata. Use this to retrieve images or other inline content embedded in messages.

messageId.description: Message ID containing the hosted content

replyId.description: Reply ID if downloading hosted content from a reply to a message (optional)

hostedContentId.description: Specific hosted content ID to download. If not provided, downloads all hosted contents from the message.

savePath.description: Optional file path to save the content. Supports UNC paths (e.g., \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\tmp\file.png).

tools.name: delete_channel_message
tools.description: Soft delete a message in a channel. Only the message sender can delete their own messages. The message will be marked as deleted.

replyId.description: Reply ID if deleting a reply to a message (optional)

tools.name: update_channel_message
tools.description: Update (edit) a message in a channel that was previously sent. Only the message sender can update their own messages.

replyId.description: Reply ID if updating a reply to a message (optional)

mentions.description: Array of @mentions to include in the message

userId.description: Azure AD User ID of the mentioned user

tools.name: set_channel_message_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction to a message in a Teams channel. Supports Unicode emoji characters and named reactions (like, angry, sad, laugh, heart, surprised). Can also react to replies.

reactionType.description: Reaction type - Unicode emoji (e.g., "👍") or named reaction (e.g., "like", "heart")

replyId.description: Reply ID if reacting to a reply (optional)

tools.name: unset_channel_message_reaction
tools.description: Remove a reaction from a message in a Teams channel. Can also remove reactions from replies.

messageId.description: Message ID to remove reaction from

reactionType.description: Reaction type to remove - Unicode emoji (e.g., "👍") or named reaction (e.g., "like", "heart")

replyId.description: Reply ID if removing reaction from a reply (optional)

tools.name: send_file_to_channel
tools.description: Upload a local file and send it as a message to a Teams channel. Supports any file type (PDF, DOCX, ZIP, images, etc.). The file is uploaded to the channel's SharePoint folder and sent as a reference attachment. If messageId is provided, the file is sent as a reply to that message (thread).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload

message.description: Optional message text to accompany the file

fileName.description: Optional custom filename (defaults to the original file name)

messageId.description: Optional message ID to reply to. When provided, the file is sent as a reply in the message thread instead of a new message.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List all recent chats (1:1 conversations and group chats) that the current user participates in. Returns chat topics, types, and participant information.

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Retrieve recent messages from a specific chat conversation. Returns message content, sender information, and timestamps.

limit.description: Number of messages to retrieve (default: 20, max: 2000)

since.description: Get messages since this ISO datetime

until.description: Get messages until this ISO datetime

fromUser.description: Filter messages from specific user ID

fetchAll.description: Fetch all messages using pagination (up to limit). When true, follows @odata.nextLink to get more messages.

contentFormat.description: Format for message content. "markdown" (default) converts Teams HTML to clean Markdown optimized for LLMs. "raw" returns original HTML from Graph API.

tools.name: download_chat_hosted_content
tools.description: Download hosted content (such as images) from a chat message. Returns the content as base64 encoded data along with metadata. Use this to retrieve images or other inline content embedded in chat messages.

messageId.description: Message ID containing the hosted content

hostedContentId.description: Specific hosted content ID to download. If not provided, downloads all hosted contents from the message.

savePath.description: Optional file path to save the content. Supports UNC paths (e.g., \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\tmp\file.png).

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a message to a specific chat conversation. Supports text and markdown formatting, mentions, and importance levels.

mentions.description: Array of @mentions to include in the message

userId.description: Azure AD User ID of the mentioned user

tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Create a new chat conversation. Can be a 1:1 chat (with one other user) or a group chat (with multiple users). Group chats can optionally have a topic.

userEmails.description: Array of user email addresses to add to chat

tools.name: update_chat_message
tools.description: Update (edit) a chat message that was previously sent. Only the message sender can update their own messages. Supports updating content with text or Markdown formatting, mentions, and importance levels.

mentions.description: Array of @mentions to include in the message

userId.description: Azure AD User ID of the mentioned user

tools.name: delete_chat_message
tools.description: Soft delete a chat message that was previously sent. Only the message sender can delete their own messages. The message will be marked as deleted but can still be seen as '[This message has been deleted]'.

tools.name: set_chat_message_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction to a message in a chat conversation. Supports Unicode emoji characters and named reactions (like, angry, sad, laugh, heart, surprised).

reactionType.description: Reaction type - Unicode emoji (e.g., "👍") or named reaction (e.g., "like", "heart")

tools.name: unset_chat_message_reaction
tools.description: Remove a reaction from a message in a chat conversation.

messageId.description: Message ID to remove reaction from

reactionType.description: Reaction type to remove - Unicode emoji (e.g., "👍") or named reaction (e.g., "like", "heart")

tools.name: send_file_to_chat
tools.description: Upload a local file and send it as a message to a Teams chat. Supports any file type (PDF, DOCX, ZIP, images, etc.). The file is uploaded to OneDrive and sent as a reference attachment.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload

message.description: Optional message text to accompany the file

fileName.description: Optional custom filename (defaults to the original file name)

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description:
Search for messages across all Microsoft Teams channels and chats using the Microsoft Search API.
The query string supports KQL (Keyword Query Language) syntax for advanced filtering:
  from:<name>              — messages sent by a person (e.g. from:bob)
  to:<name>                — messages sent to a person
  mentions:<userId>        — messages that mention a specific user ID (without dashes)
  IsMentioned:true         — messages that mention the current user
  hasAttachment:true|false — filter by attachment presence
  IsRead:true|false        — filter by read status
  sent>=YYYY-MM-DD         — messages sent on or after a date
  sent<=YYYY-MM-DD         — messages sent on or before a date
Examples:
  "quarterly report" from:alice sent>=2025-01-01
  hasAttachment:true from:bob
  project update sent>=2025-02-01
Use get_chat_messages or get_channel_messages for browsing a specific conversation.

query.description: Search query string. Supports KQL syntax (see tool description)

from.description: Offset for pagination (0-based). Use with size to paginate through results

enableTopResults.description: When true, results are ranked by relevance. When false, results are unranked

contentFormat.description: Format for message content. "markdown" (default) converts Teams HTML to clean Markdown optimized for LLMs. "raw" returns original HTML from Graph API.

tools.name: get_my_mentions
tools.description: Find recent messages where the current user was @mentioned across all Teams channels and chats.

hours.description: Look back this many hours (max 168 = 1 week)

size.description: Maximum number of mentions to return

contentFormat.description: Format for message content. "markdown" (default) converts Teams HTML to clean Markdown optimized for LLMs. "raw" returns original HTML from Graph API.

tools.name: find_meetings
tools.description: Find Teams meetings using fuzzy multi-criteria search. Use this FIRST when the user references a meeting by name, attendees, or an approximate date. Supports free-text query, subject substring, participant name/email, and a date range. Returns the top matches ranked by a weighted score with human-readable match reasons. Note: Microsoft Graph only returns meetings the signed-in user organized. Meetings you only attended will not appear.

query.description: Free-text fuzzy query matched against meeting subject (e.g. 'q4 kickof')

subjectContains.description: Case-insensitive substring the subject must contain

participantNameOrEmail.description: Substring match against any participant's display name, UPN, or email address

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start of the search window. Defaults to 30 days ago.

endDateTime.description: ISO 8601 end of the search window. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Max results to return. Default 10, max 25.

tools.name: list_online_meetings
tools.description: List the signed-in user's online meetings chronologically. Prefer find_meetings when the user has a specific meeting in mind. Note: Microsoft Graph only returns meetings the signed-in user organized. Meetings you only attended will not appear.

top.description: Max meetings to return. Default 20, max 50.

tools.name: get_online_meeting
tools.description: Fetch a single online meeting by meeting ID or by Teams join URL (auto-detected). Note: Microsoft Graph only returns meetings the signed-in user organized. Meetings you only attended will not appear.

meetingIdOrJoinUrl.description: Either a meeting ID returned by find_meetings or list_online_meetings, or a full Teams join URL starting with https://teams.microsoft.com/

tools.name: list_meeting_transcripts
tools.description: List all available transcripts for a specific meeting. Returns an empty array if the meeting was not recorded with transcription enabled.

meetingId.description: Meeting ID returned by find_meetings, list_online_meetings, or get_online_meeting

tools.name: get_meeting_transcript_content
tools.description: Fetch WebVTT transcript content with speaker attribution (e.g. <v Alice Example>). Returns at most 50,000 characters per call by default to avoid overwhelming context. For long meetings, the response will be marked `truncated: true` with a `nextOffset` you can pass as `startOffset` to fetch the next slice. Do NOT request the full transcript (large `maxChars`) unless the user explicitly asks for the complete verbatim content — summarizing from a single default-sized slice is usually sufficient. Use list_meeting_transcripts first to get the transcriptId.

startOffset.description: Character offset to start reading from. Default 0.

maxChars.description: Max chars to return. Default 50000, capped at 500000.
